## Observations

- Raising `step_limit` from 100 to 250 lifted pass rate from 1/10 to 2/10: `dottxt_ai_outlines_task/1655` submitted at step 223 and passed alongside `pallets_jinja_task/1621` (submitted at step 112).
- The remaining 8 pairs still hit `LimitsExceeded` at step 250 with `0` commits and `0` pushes (`patch_lines == 0`) across 15 to 31 context compactions: 5 of the 8 applied local edits (`go_chi/26`, `huggingface_datasets/6252`, `openai_tiktoken/0`, `pallets_click/2800`, `pallets_jinja/1559`) and kept iterating without knowing step 250 would stop them, while 3 (`dspy/8394`, `pillow/290`, `typst/6554`) never moved past reading and reproduction scripts.
- At `-c 10`, launch-wave input load briefly exceeded the 1M/min cap (`1,271,868` tok/min in minute +2), causing 64 `429` retries and 2 `5xx` retries that all recovered via backoff (`0` agent errors).
